about.title: Our story
about.intro: For over 5 years, Le Premier Aout Decor has been dressing the finest homes in Nouakchott.
about.story_text: Born from a deep passion for interior design and fine craftsmanship, Le Premier Aout Decor has become a reference in premium furniture in Mauritania. Every piece in our catalog — from the Shiba salon to the Prada bedroom — is hand-picked for its elegance, durability, and ability to transform a space into a genuine experience.
about.value1_text: Noble materials, careful finishes, and meticulous attention to detail in every product.
about.value2_text: Tailored advice, home delivery, and after-sales support — via WhatsApp, anytime.
about.value3_text: Certain pieces can be adapted to your dimensions and preferences — just tell us.
about.cta_text: Send us a WhatsApp message — we reply the same day.
